title: S102 6.1 Reliable Delivery and Replies by Email
parent_path: S102 6.1 Reliable Delivery and Replies by Email

statements.subject: session
statements.description: When the receiver-SMTP accepts a piece of mail (by sending a '250 OK' message in response to DATA), it is accepting responsibility for delivering or relaying the message.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: When the receiver-SMTP accepts a piece of mail (by sending a '250 OK' message in response to DATA), it is accepting responsibility for delivering or relaying the message.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: To avoid receiving duplicate messages as the result of timeouts, a receiver-SMTP MUST seek to minimize the time required to respond to the final <CRLF>.<CRLF> end of data indicator.

statements.subject: server
statements.description: If there is a delivery failure after acceptance of a message, the receiver-SMTP MUST formulate and mail a notification message. This notification MUST be sent using a null ('<>') reverse-path in the envelope.
statements.pre_cond: session.state = MAIL_ACCEPTED & message.delivery_failure = true & message.return_path != null
actions: send notification with null reverse-path to envelope return-path address

statements.subject: server
statements.description: However, if this address is null ('<>'), the receiver-SMTP MUST NOT send a notification.
statements.pre_cond: session.state = MAIL_ACCEPTED & message.delivery_failure = true & message.return_path = null
